notes: Projects keep going until you pause or stop them: errors are retried by themselves, a lost internet connection is waited out, a used-up run budget is extended, unfinished work gets more rounds while it improves, and after a restart of the app or the Mac work continues (the app adds itself to Login Items once). Shell commands are judged by the programs they run, so everyday commands no longer ask again and again, and an unanswered question waits 5 minutes instead of 20. Needs the new app (DMG).
